environment: Local macOS linked database/object storage, private Docker API/Celery/ONNX worker; bundled Chromium with Apple M3 Metal

models.name: CubiCasa5K · floor-plan regions
models.license: CC-BY-NC-4.0; retain CubiCasa5K attribution; noncommercial scope
models.evaluation: Reviewed assistance only. Two original published test plans: pixel accuracy 0.87195, mean class IoU 0.65622; room class errors remain. Rectangular ONNX/PyTorch label agreement >99.9995%. This is a small feasibility evaluation, not cadastral or Indian pilot accuracy.

models.name: RF-DETR · building outlines
models.license: Apache-2.0 model card; retain RF-DETR and checkpoint attribution
models.evaluation: Reviewed assistance only. Fixed 12 published OAM/OSM test tiles using this runtime: aggregate IoU 0.2874, precision 0.3418, recall 0.6434. Clear occupied tiles reach IoU 0.57–0.86; empty and blurred scenes show false positives. No threshold tuning. Single-tile feasibility results do not establish tiled boundary accuracy; overlap union may merge touching roofs and retain edge false positives. No cadastral or Indian pilot accuracy claim.

preservation.verification_only: one new explicitly synthetic ML area/property with authored controls and levels

limits: Model quality is reviewed assistance, not cadastral qualification; weak building tiles and merged floor regions remain documented.
CubiCasa model is noncommercial; model and dataset attribution retained.
Physical device, formal screen reader and complete true-200%-browser-zoom acceptance remain unverified.
Historical free Nous credential and Indian survey gates remain open.
City-scale streaming, every source-format adapter and clean-machine release qualification are not claimed.
